content: dinit shutdown ordering fixed via stop-command guards on dbus/elogind: scripts wait bounded (pidof) for turnstiled exit then stop the daemon; stop-timeout=30 failsafe; no-op without turnstile. feralos-aports 75c566a, ADR-007, harness 63/63 run 2026-09-30T00-08-04Z.

dinit 0.21 stop semantics (source-verified + local repro): release_dependencies() runs when a dependent BEGINS stopping (prop_release), not at exit; stop_check_dependents uses holding_acq; stop-command REPLACES the TERM signal (script must kill the process itself; stop-timeout -> SIGKILL). Alpine busybox pgrep has no -x — use pidof.

Artix dinit conventions (2026-09-30 audit, gitea.artixlinux.org): before=login.target everywhere; /usr/lib/dinit wrappers + .script companions; pipefd readiness (dbus:4, seatd:3 via -n 3, pipewire user pipevar: on dinit 0.22); companion -pre services (dbus-pre cgroup+sv-cg.sh, ssh-keygen); smooth-recovery=true default style (no auto-restart); user services now via userspawn-dinit (turnstile-dinit still shipped, seds log to /var/log/dinit/); base suite = artix/dinit-rc, dinit 0.22.1. FeralOS divergences (chimera base, direct commands, restart=true) are stylistic — fixed parity items only.

Logging Round 1: klogd-dinit kernel-ring relay (busybox klogd -n -> /dev/log -> vector kern.log + /var/log/dmesg snapshot; dinit-only, OpenRC klogd needs `logger` replaced by vector); vector config hardened (drop *.log.1 include = copytruncate duplicates; disk buffers max_size 268435488 = Vector 256MiB min); harness 4 new checks. aports f2842dc single push CI green; harness 67/67 run 2026-09-30T22-52-14Z.

Vector has NO kernel/kmsg source (official catalog 0.55: journald/file/socket/exec; no /dev/kmsg reader) — kernel ring bridge must be external. Alpine busybox klogd exists (/sbin/klogd, -n foreground) but its OpenRC script has depend() need logger (busybox syslogd) -> unusable with vector-only; use a dedicated dinit service instead. /proc/kmsg replay starts at the oldest buffered record so klogd-style readers see the full boot log. Vector disk buffer max_size minimum is 268435488 bytes (256MiB).
